name: Puffcorn
ingredients_raw: Cereal Products (68%) (Corn Meal (54%), Rice Meal (14%)), Edible Vegetable Oil, *Seasoning (Sugar, lodised Salt, Maltodextrin, Spices and Condiments, Milk Solids, Cheese Powder (0.5%), Salt Substitute (Potassium Chloride), Edible Starch, Flavour (Natural and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances), Flavour Enhancers (627, 631), Acidity Regulators (296,330)), Gran Meal, Firming Agent (170(i)), lodised Salt. As flavouring agent. To know the specific type of oil used and its saturated fat value, match the symbol or with the last character of batch number where ◊ denotes Palmolein and #denotes Rice Bran Oil. ALLERGEN ADVICE: Contains Milk, Soy. May Contain Wheat.
